phrases.english: Your voice grows, with each sentence.
phrases.russian: Ваш голос растёт, с каждым предложением.

phrases.english: Learn a little, feel joy tonight.
One new sound, progress is here.
Listen to the hum of the unsaid.
The smallest flicker can light the vastest dark.
phrases.russian: Малейшая искра может осветить безмерную тьму.

phrases.english: Growth often wears the cloak of challenge.
Savor the echo of your own kindness.
Ink dried slow, mind is clear.
A bit understood, more to glean.
Like a strong oak, stand tall.
Your inner voice, guides you well.
phrases.russian: Твой внутренний глас, ведёт тебя верно.

phrases.english: Sculpt your moment, don't just endure it.
phrases.russian: Ваяйте свой миг, а не просто переживайте его.

phrases.english: Ignite the quiet hum of your purpose.
The future blooms from today's seedling.
Find your echo in the effort.
Turn obstacles into stepping stones for wonder.
phrases.russian: Превратите препятствия в ступеньки к чуду.

phrases.english: Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack.
Lost in your gaze, found my world.
phrases.russian: Потерялся в твоём взгляде, нашёл свой мир.

phrases.english: You're the missing piece I didn't know I craved.
phrases.russian: Ты – недостающая часть, которую я не знал, что жаждал.

phrases.english: My calm amidst your beautiful chaos.
phrases.russian: Моё спокойствие посреди твоего прекрасного хаоса.

phrases.english: With you, every ordinary day feels like an adventure.
phrases.russian: С тобой каждый обычный день кажется приключением.
Сбрасывай то, что больше не питает.

phrases.english: Whispers of growth in quiet spaces.
The world turns in slow time.
Each sunrise paints a new opportunity.
Embrace the quiet hum of presence.
Your kindness is a ripple in time.
phrases.russian: Твоя доброта — это рябь во времени.

phrases.english: Find joy in the unexpected pause.
Sunbeam tracing across a worn book.
The quiet hum of contented breath.
The sweet aroma after sudden rain.
Breathing in the space between thoughts.
Choose warmth, even on hard days
phrases.russian: Выбирай тепло, даже в трудные дни

phrases.english: Good morning, have a great day.
Never give up on your dreams.
phrases.russian: Никогда не отказывайся от своих мечтаний.

phrases.english: Every day is a fresh start.
Small steps lead to big changes.
phrases.russian: Маленькие шаги ведут к большим переменам.

phrases.english: You are stronger than you think.
Happiness is a choice, choose it.
I would like a coffee please.
